$meta.status: CAPTURED from the client's existing profile (not a new design). Not yet approved by the client.
$meta.source: _originals/otlobny_company-profile_original_2026-11-13.pdf: vector fills on page 20 and pixel samples of pages 1, 6, 10, 16 rendered at 110 and 400 dpi
$meta.colour_space: sRGB. No CMYK or Pantone values exist in the source; to be matched by the printer if the profile is ever printed.
$meta.contrast: WCAG 2.x contrast ratio. AA needs 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text (18 pt+, or 14 pt+ bold) and for graphic elements.

blue.name: Royal blue
blue.origin: wordmark colour on page 1; light end of the page gradient on page 20 (vector stop 21.5% 34.6% 69.0%)

green.name: Green
green.origin: vector fill on page 20 (35.2% 77.1% 51.9%); accents of the wordmark on page 1
green.use: accent only: wordmark accents, rules, markers, icons and large numerals on navy. Never text on white or on the light tint.

navy.name: Navy
navy.origin: dark end of the page gradient on page 20 (vector stop 12.0% 19.1% 38.3%)
navy.use: dark backgrounds, headings and body text on light backgrounds

tint.name: Light tint
tint.origin: pale panels and dotted backgrounds on pages 10 and 16

periwinkle.name: Periwinkle tint
periwinkle.use: pattern and decoration only; secondary text on navy. Never text on white.

white.name: White
white.use: page background; text and one-colour logo on navy and on royal blue

ink.name: Ink (text black)
ink.origin: body text on white pages of the original
ink.use: optional body text colour on white; navy is preferred so the document stays in three brand colours

grey.name: Descriptor grey
grey.origin: descriptor line under the logo on page 1
grey.use: descriptor line of the colour lockup; captions

green-deep.name: Deep green (PROPOSED, not in the original)
green-deep.origin: agency proposal: the brand green darkened until it passes AA as text on white
green-deep.use: only where green text or thin green lines must sit on white or the light tint (page numbers, small labels). Needs client approval; until then use navy.

brand.note: White text passes AA across the whole gradient (6.59 to 12.55). Green on the light end is only 3.06: keep green text and thin green details on the dark half.

type_scale_a4_landscape_pt.note: Page 297 x 210 mm. Arabic sizes are about 12 to 15% larger than the Latin so the two scripts read as equal.

both.font: Tajawal digits in Arabic blocks, IBM Plex Sans Bold in Latin blocks

sparkle.construction: four-point star with concave sides, as in the logo badge
sparkle.use: repeat pattern on a square grid; single accent

diagonal.use: image masks and panel edges; taken from the diagonal cuts inside the wordmark

pill.construction: rectangle with fully rounded ends, as the dot of the ya in the wordmark

logo.clear_space: X = width of the alef (21.34 units = 6.9% of the logo width) on every side
logo.status: clear space and minimum sizes are agency recommendations; the original states none
